scope: primary research sources and selected reading ranges; two abstract-only sources remain explicit; not a systematic-review completeness claim

sources.title: An assessment model for proof comprehension in undergraduate mathematics
sources.read_scope: 作者稿PDF相關選段：第7–15、18–24頁；模型形成、三類局部與四類整體理解
sources.evidence: 文獻與九名數學家訪談形成評估模型；非介入因果試驗
sources.supports: 理解診斷需同時問局部理由、整體方法、例示與轉用
sources.limits: 沒有驗證固定敘事順序或ReadFlow效果

sources.title: Self-Explanation Training Improves Proof Comprehension
sources.evidence: 三實驗；n=76；眼動n=32招募/28可用；實驗3分析n=107，20日後不同證明
sources.supports: 可訓練讀者指出邏輯關聯；理解表現有實驗支持
sources.limits: 20日是策略持續/遷移，不是同一證明的記憶保留；未驗長教材

sources.title: Expert and Novice Approaches to Reading Mathematical Proofs
sources.evidence: 18本科生、12數學家；短證明驗證眼動觀察
sources.supports: 不能把回看次數本身當閱讀缺陷
sources.limits: 單一大學、螢幕、短證明、驗證任務；眼動不直接揭示理由

sources.title: Multimedia resources designed to support learning from written proofs: an eye-movement study
sources.read_scope: 出版pp.255–256、258–263相關方法、結果、限制
sources.evidence: n=49隨機比較e-Proof與普通證明，15分鐘；2週同題延後測驗下降2.8 vs 1.3/18；time×group p=.021；另34人眼動
sources.supports: 額外解釋或討喜設計不能代替獨立與延後學習測驗
sources.limits: 音訊動畫介入不同於靜態教材；未測ReadFlow；沒有證明一切解釋有害

sources.title: The Use of Worked Examples as a Substitute for Problem Solving in Learning Algebra
sources.read_scope: 出版p.59與pp.84–86之摘要及實驗5結果
sources.evidence: 五項代數研究；例題收益主要在同結構近遷移
sources.supports: 例子應教辨識與作法；遠遷移必另測
sources.limits: 代數操作不是高階抽象證明；不支持每節固定例子數

sources.title: The split-attention effect as a factor in the design of instruction
sources.evidence: 實驗1 26位數控初學學徒；實驗2 20位教育心理學生讀報告
sources.supports: 互依資訊宜就近提供，減少無功能搜尋
sources.limits: 不等於所有資訊同頁；距離高階數學外推遠

sources.title: Levels of Expertise and Instructional Design
sources.read_scope: 只讀出版社摘要；未讀全文，無實讀正文頁
sources.evidence: 摘要報三項實驗：先備程度改變最佳支援形式
sources.supports: 冗餘相對讀者先備判斷
sources.limits: 樣本、效應與全文方法UNKNOWN；不能量化ReadFlow刪字門檻

sources.title: Measuring actual learning versus feeling of learning in response to being actively engaged in the classroom
sources.read_scope: HTML摘要、Methods、Tables 1–2及結果敘述；無固定實讀頁碼
sources.evidence: 149名初階物理學生；兩課次隨機交叉，內容相同；主動課堂測驗較好、學習感較低
sources.supports: 閱讀偏好與理解/應用分列；測題由學習目標獨立制定
sources.limits: 不能否定使用者偏好；不是難讀文字或排版實驗

sources.title: Testing the segmentation effect of multimedia learning in a biological system
sources.read_scope: 只讀出版社摘要、Lay Description、Registered Report Stage 2標記；全文連結回摘要
sources.evidence: 腎臟功能多媒體概念複現未得到分段轉移/負荷優勢
sources.supports: 分段效果非跨情境必然；靜態分段須另驗
sources.limits: 樣本與全文統計UNKNOWN；不能推翻所有分段研究

sources.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
sources.read_ranges: PDF pp.1,3–4; §2 and §3.1. Separate historical v2 HTML §6 and Appendix H.1 read, not conflated with final PDF.

sources.authors: Jie Huang, Xinyun Chen, Swaroop Mishra, Huaixiu Steven Zheng, Adams Wei Yu, Xinying Song, Denny Zhou
sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.caution: Findings concern tested then-current models and task configurations, not impossibility of self-correction by all later models.

sources.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
sources.read_ranges: Official PDF pp.4–6,15: §3.1–3.5 and Figure 8; HTML v4 Appendix D.1–D.2
sources.caution: Specific original-paper human agreement percentages are not textbook readability or learning outcomes.

sources.authors: Arjun Panickssery, Samuel R. Bowman, Shi Feng
sources.title: LLM Evaluators Recognize and Favor Their Own Generations
sources.caution: News-summary tasks, limited ground-truth quality control; same model in independent contexts is not independent model family.

sources.authors: Nelson F. Liu, Kevin Lin, John Hewitt, Ashwin Paranjape, Michele Bevilacqua, Fabio Petroni, Percy Liang
sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.venue: Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics 12, 157–173
sources.caution: Multi-document QA and key-value retrieval, not math manuscript editing; no fixed optimal context length established for this project.

sources.authors: Zhibin Gou, Zhihong Shao, Yeyun Gong, Yelong Shen, Yujiu Yang, Nan Duan, Weizhu Chen
sources.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
sources.caution: Executable math programs and QA feedback do not measure human comfort; authors mark transfer to other tasks uncertain. OpenReview PDF route hit verification page; arXiv accessible.

sources.authors: Chujie Zheng, Zhenru Zhang, Beichen Zhang, Runji Lin, Keming Lu, Bowen Yu, Dayiheng Liu, Jingren Zhou, Junyang Lin
sources.title: ProcessBench: Identifying Process Errors in Mathematical Reasoning
sources.caution: Mainly competition/Olympiad math; human labels may contain errors. Their F1 denotes harmonic mean of erroneous/correct subset accuracies, not generic precision-recall F1.

sources.authors: Zhi-Yuan Chen, Hao Wang, Xinyu Zhang, Enrui Hu, Yankai Lin
sources.title: Beyond the Surface: Measuring Self-Preference in LLM Judgments
sources.caution: Gold judgments are mainly from other LLM judges (GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-Flash, DeepSeek-V3), not independent human truth; tasks instruction-following and translation.
